minimize.geometry: Fixed global cosine and fixed source intercepts, per-frame independent edge amplitudes; last16px above Dock and rounded corners excluded when enough rows exist.

restore.inlier_note: Inlier subsets use residual-based rejection and are explicitly not independent accuracy estimates. All-raw statistics retain text/corner/codec edge-detection mistakes.

warning: Spatial fit on measured reference frames. Held-out rows do not establish temporal fidelity between recordings or current macOS behavior; outliers retained in all-raw statistics. Rounded corners, shadow, Dock blending and hidden sheet are not exact.
